```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(units)
  library(Cairo)
})

# ============================================================
# TF-centric subnet plot (ANANSE diffnetwork + DESeq2 colouring)
#
# Goal:
#   For a user-chosen TF (from ANANSE influence list), plot a star
#   network with the TF in the centre and:
#     (1) all DE targets it regulates (padj + abs(log2FC) thresholds)
#     (2) optionally: additional top non-DE targets by abs(weight)
#         plotted in grey to provide context (toggle ON/OFF)
#
# Edge thickness: scaled by abs(weight)
# Node colour:
#   - DE targets + centre TF: log2FC (blue->white->red)
#   - non-DE extra targets: fixed grey
#
# Notes:
#   - Targets not found in DESeq2 (e.g. Ensembl IDs) are excluded by
#     default, but can be included with include_unmatched_targets=TRUE.
#   - Star layout guarantees the chosen TF is centred.
# ============================================================

# ----------------------------
# Input files (your paths)
# ----------------------------
influence_file <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence.txt"

diffnet_file   <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence_diffnetwork.tsv"

deseq_file     <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_nfcore_tfactivity/tfactivity_results/HSC_50kbp_window_JASPAR2024_all_vert_motifs_Old_over_Young/01_counts/05_deseq2/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC.deseq2.results.tsv"


# ----------------------------
# User knobs
# ----------------------------
tf_of_interest <- "MAF"    # <-- set to any TF symbol in influence_file

# Edge selection
min_abs_edge_wt <- 0.0000001     # only keep edges where abs(weight) >= this

# DE target definition
padj_cutoff    <- 0.05
abs_lfc_cutoff <- 0.0       # set >0 if you want effect-size threshold for DE targets

# Sparsity control:
# Always keep DE targets. Optionally add extra non-DE targets by abs(weight) (grey) to densify plot.
add_top_nonDE_targets <- TRUE
n_top_nonDE_targets   <- 10     # number of non-DE (but matched) targets added by abs(weight)

# Include targets not found in DESeq2 (e.g. Ensembl IDs)?
include_unmatched_targets <- FALSE
n_unmatched_targets       <- 25  # if include_unmatched_targets=TRUE, cap how many to add

# Total cap (prevents pathological hairballs)
max_targets_total <- 150

# Aesthetics
edge_col         <- "grey60"
edge_alpha       <- 0.55
edge_width_range <- c(0.2, 2.2)
arrow_mm         <- 2.5

center_tf_size   <- 14
target_size      <- 14

tf_target_shape  <- 22  # square (TF targets + centre TF)
gene_target_shape<- 21  # circle (gene targets)

node_border      <- "grey10"
nonDE_fill       <- "grey70"
unmatched_fill   <- "grey85"

# Colour gradient for log2FC (DE nodes + centre TF)
fc_low  <- "blue3"
fc_mid  <- "white"
fc_high <- "red3"

# Labels
label_nodes <- TRUE
label_fill_col        <- "white"
label_fill_alpha      <- 0.55
label_text_col        <- "black"
label_border_size     <- 0.0
label_padding_lines   <- 0.15
label_radius_lines    <- 0.15

# Output
out_dir <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/GRN_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

out_pdf   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("ANANSE_TFsubnet_", tf_of_interest, "_Young2Old.pdf"))
out_width <- 10
out_height<- 8


# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing <- function(path) if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)

read_influence <- function(path) {
  readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA"))
}

read_diffnet <- function(path) {
  readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
    dplyr::select(source, target, weight)
}

read_deseq <- function(path) {
  readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj)
}


# ----------------------------
# Load data
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing(influence_file)
stop_if_missing(diffnet_file)
stop_if_missing(deseq_file)

inf     <- read_influence(influence_file)
diffnet <- read_diffnet(diffnet_file)
de      <- read_deseq(deseq_file)

if (!("factor" %in% colnames(inf))) stop("Influence file missing column: factor")
tf_universe <- unique(inf$factor)

if (!(tf_of_interest %in% tf_universe)) {
  stop("tf_of_interest not found in influence 'factor' column: ", tf_of_interest)
}

# Prepare DESeq2 annotation
de2 <- de %>%
  mutate(
    abs_lfc = abs(log2FoldChange),
    de_status = case_when(
      is.na(padj) | is.na(log2FoldChange) ~ NA_character_,
      padj <= padj_cutoff & abs_lfc >= abs_lfc_cutoff & log2FoldChange >  0 ~ "up",
      padj <= padj_cutoff & abs_lfc >= abs_lfc_cutoff & log2FoldChange <  0 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    is_DE = de_status %in% c("up", "down")
  )

# ----------------------------
# Extract TF-centric edges
# ----------------------------
edges0 <- diffnet %>%
  filter(source == tf_of_interest) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

message("Edges from ", tf_of_interest, " (pre-filter): ", nrow(edges0))

edges1 <- edges0 %>%
  filter(abs_weight >= min_abs_edge_wt) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_weight))

message("Edges after abs(weight) >= ", min_abs_edge_wt, ": ", nrow(edges1))

if (nrow(edges1) == 0) {
  stop("No edges remain after filtering. Lower min_abs_edge_wt.")
}

# Join DESeq2 info onto targets
edges2 <- edges1 %>%
  left_join(de2, by = c("target" = "gene_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_deseq = !is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(padj),
    is_DE = dplyr::coalesce(is_DE, FALSE)   # <- THIS is the key fix
  )

message("Targets matched in DESeq2: ", sum(edges2$has_deseq))
message("Targets that are DE (should be >0 if any): ", sum(edges2$is_DE))
print(head(edges2 %>% filter(is_DE) %>% select(target, log2FoldChange, padj, abs_weight), 10))

# ----------------------------
# Choose which targets to keep
# ----------------------------

# 1) Always keep DE targets
edges_keep_DE <- edges2 %>%
  filter(has_deseq, is_DE) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_weight))

# 2) Optionally add non-DE targets by abs(weight) (grey context nodes)
edges_keep_nonDE <- edges2[0, ]  # empty default
if (isTRUE(add_top_nonDE_targets)) {
  edges_keep_nonDE <- edges2 %>%
    filter(has_deseq, !is_DE) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top_nonDE_targets)
}

# 3) Optionally add unmatched targets (not in DESeq2) (typically Ensembl IDs)
edges_keep_unmatched <- edges2[0, ]
if (isTRUE(include_unmatched_targets)) {
  edges_keep_unmatched <- edges2 %>%
    filter(!has_deseq) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_unmatched_targets)
}

# Combine and cap total
edges_keep <- bind_rows(edges_keep_DE, edges_keep_nonDE, edges_keep_unmatched) %>%
  distinct(source, target, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_weight)) %>%
  slice_head(n = max_targets_total)

message("Edges kept: DE=", nrow(edges_keep_DE),
        " + nonDE=", nrow(edges_keep_nonDE),
        " + unmatched=", nrow(edges_keep_unmatched),
        " => total=", nrow(edges_keep))

if (nrow(edges_keep) == 0) {
  stop("No targets remain after selection. Try lowering thresholds or enabling add_top_nonDE_targets/include_unmatched_targets.")
}

# ----------------------------
# Build node table
# ----------------------------
nodes <- tibble(name = unique(c(tf_of_interest, edges_keep$target))) %>%
  mutate(
    is_center = name == tf_of_interest,
    is_tf = name %in% tf_universe,
    node_class = case_when(
      is_center ~ "center_TF",
      is_tf ~ "TF_target",
      TRUE ~ "gene_target"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(de2, by = c("name" = "gene_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_deseq = !is.na(log2FoldChange),
    is_DE = is_DE %in% TRUE
  )

# Make centre TF neutral if not in DESeq2
nodes <- nodes %>%
  mutate(
    log2FoldChange = if_else(is_center & is.na(log2FoldChange), 0, log2FoldChange),
    padj = if_else(is_center & is.na(padj), 1, padj),
    has_deseq = if_else(is_center, TRUE, has_deseq)
  )

message("Nodes total: ", nrow(nodes))
message("Targets that are TFs: ", sum(nodes$node_class == "TF_target"))
message("Targets that are genes: ", sum(nodes$node_class == "gene_target"))
message("Targets missing DESeq2 match (if included): ", sum(!nodes$is_center & !nodes$has_deseq))

# ----------------------------
# Build igraph object
# ----------------------------
g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges_keep %>% select(source, target, weight, abs_weight),
  vertices = nodes,
  directed = TRUE
)

# Node sizes
V(g)$size <- ifelse(V(g)$node_class == "center_TF", center_tf_size, target_size)

# Shapes (store as numeric codes; we'll use scale_shape_identity)
V(g)$shape <- ifelse(V(g)$node_class %in% c("center_TF", "TF_target"), tf_target_shape, gene_target_shape)

# Edge thickness
E(g)$edge_width <- rescale(E(g)$abs_weight, to = edge_width_range)

# Labels
V(g)$plot_label <- if (isTRUE(label_nodes)) V(g)$name else NA_character_


# ----------------------------
# Layout: star (manual) with centre TF fixed
# ----------------------------
center_idx <- which(V(g)$name == tf_of_interest)
coords <- layout_as_star(g, center = center_idx)

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------
p <- ggraph(g, layout = "manual", x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2]) +

  # Edges
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(width = edge_width),
    colour = edge_col,
    alpha = edge_alpha,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(arrow_mm, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    end_cap = circle(2.5, "mm")
  ) +
  scale_edge_width_identity() +

  # Non-DE targets (grey) layer
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, !is_center, has_deseq, !is_DE),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = nonDE_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +

  # Unmatched targets (grey85) layer (only if included)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, !is_center, !has_deseq),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = unmatched_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +

  # DE targets + centre TF (log2FC gradient)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, is_center | is_DE),
    aes(fill = log2FoldChange, size = size, shape = shape),
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  scale_shape_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = fc_low, mid = fc_mid, high = fc_high,
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "log2FC\n(Old vs Young)"
  ) +

  # Optional labels (framed)
  geom_node_label(
    aes(label = plot_label),
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, !is.na(plot_label)),
    fill = scales::alpha(label_fill_col, label_fill_alpha),
    colour = label_text_col,
    label.size = label_border_size,
    label.padding = unit(label_padding_lines, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(label_radius_lines, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  theme_void() +
  ggtitle(paste0(
    "TF subnet: ", tf_of_interest,
    " | abs(weight)≥", min_abs_edge_wt,
    " | DE: padj≤", padj_cutoff, ", absLFC≥", abs_lfc_cutoff,
    if (add_top_nonDE_targets) paste0(" | +", n_top_nonDE_targets, " non-DE") else ""
  )) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------
ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = out_width, height = out_height, device = cairo_pdf)
message("Saved plot to: ", out_pdf)

if (interactive()) print(p)
```


```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(units)
  library(Cairo)
})

# ============================================================
# 2-step branching subnet plot for ANANSE influence intuition
#
# - Builds outward ego graph (radius = max_steps) around tf_of_interest
# - Optionally keeps only "outward" edges (layer(u)+1 == layer(v))
#   so the plot branches TF1 -> (TF2, genes) -> genes
# - TF nodes = squares, gene nodes = circles
# - DE nodes coloured by directional log2FC (blue->white->red)
# - Optionally add top non-DE genes by incoming edge strength (grey) to densify plot
# - Edge thickness either:
#     (a) direct edge weight ("edge")
#     (b) simple 2-step proxy ("path2"): for layer1->2 edges, width ~ w(TF1->TF2)*w(TF2->gene)
#
# Built-in diagnostics will stop early with helpful messages if filtering
# removes too many nodes/edges.
# ============================================================

# ----------------------------
# Input files
# ----------------------------
influence_file <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence.txt"

diffnet_file   <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence_diffnetwork.tsv"

deseq_file     <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_nfcore_tfactivity/tfactivity_results/HSC_50kbp_window_JASPAR2024_all_vert_motifs_Old_over_Young/01_counts/05_deseq2/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC.deseq2.results.tsv"


# ----------------------------
# User knobs
# ----------------------------
tf_of_interest <- "MAF"   # TF being assessed

max_steps <- 2

# diffnetwork is already filtered to weights>0 by ANANSE, but you can tighten:
min_edge_weight <- 0.01

# DE definition (for deciding which genes are DE targets)
padj_cutoff    <- 0.05
abs_lfc_cutoff <- 0.25

# Densify plot: keep DE genes plus top non-DE genes by incoming edge strength
add_top_nonDE_genes <- FALSE
n_top_nonDE_genes   <- 40

# Include targets missing from DESeq2 (often Ensembl IDs) as grey?
include_unmatched_genes <- FALSE
n_unmatched_genes       <- 25

# Branching structure: keep only outward edges (recommended)
keep_outward_edges <- TRUE

# Edge width definition:
#  "edge"  = direct edge weight
#  "path2" = simple 2-step proxy for layer1->2 edges: w(TF1->TF2)*w(TF2->gene)
edge_width_mode <- "path2"

# Aesthetics
tf_shape   <- 22
gene_shape <- 21
node_border <- "grey85"

nonDE_fill     <- "grey70"
unmatched_fill <- "grey85"

edge_col   <- "grey10"
edge_alpha <- 1
edge_width_range <- c(0.4, 2.2)
arrow_mm   <- 2.3

fc_low  <- "blue3"
fc_mid  <- "white"
fc_high <- "red3"

# Labels: label TFs + top DE genes
label_tfs <- TRUE
label_top_de_genes <- TRUE
n_label_de_genes <- 25

# --- Label positioning, border and color---
label_nudge_x <- 0.00      # + moves right, - moves left
label_nudge_y <- 0.05      # + moves up, - moves down
label_hjust   <- 0.5       # 0=left, 0.5=center, 1=right
label_vjust   <- 1       # 0=bottom, 0.5=center, 1=top
label_box_padding_lines <- 0.12   # padding around label text
label_box_radius_lines  <- 0.12   # rounded corners
label_fill_col   <- "white"
label_fill_alpha <- 0.3
label_text_col   <- "black"
label_border_size <- 0.0

# Output
out_dir <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/GRN_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

out_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("ANANSE_2step_branch_", tf_of_interest, "_Young2Old.pdf"))
out_width <- 12
out_height <- 9


# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing <- function(path) if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)

msg_counts <- function(label, g) {
  message(label, ": nodes=", vcount(g), " edges=", ecount(g))
}

# ----------------------------
# Load
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing(influence_file)
stop_if_missing(diffnet_file)
stop_if_missing(deseq_file)

inf <- read_tsv(influence_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA"))
if (!("factor" %in% colnames(inf))) stop("Influence file missing column 'factor'.")

diffnet <- read_tsv(diffnet_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
  select(source, target, weight) %>%
  filter(!is.na(source), !is.na(target), !is.na(weight))

# Filter edges by threshold
diffnet <- diffnet %>% filter(weight >= min_edge_weight)
if (nrow(diffnet) == 0) stop("No edges after min_edge_weight filtering; lower min_edge_weight.")

tf_universe <- union(unique(inf$factor), unique(diffnet$source))
if (!(tf_of_interest %in% tf_universe)) stop("tf_of_interest not in influence file: ", tf_of_interest)

de <- read_tsv(deseq_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
  select(gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj)

de2 <- de %>%
  mutate(
    abs_lfc = abs(log2FoldChange),
    is_DE = !is.na(padj) & !is.na(log2FoldChange) &
      (padj <= padj_cutoff) & (abs_lfc >= abs_lfc_cutoff)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Build full graph
# ----------------------------
g_all <- graph_from_data_frame(diffnet, directed = TRUE)
E(g_all)$weight <- diffnet$weight
msg_counts("g_all (after min_edge_weight)", g_all)

if (!(tf_of_interest %in% V(g_all)$name)) {
  stop("TF not found as a node in g_all after filtering: ", tf_of_interest,
       "\nTry lowering min_edge_weight or confirm TF is present in diffnetwork.")
}

# ----------------------------
# Ego graph (outward) within max_steps
# ----------------------------
ego_vids <- ego(g_all, order = max_steps, nodes = tf_of_interest, mode = "out")[[1]]
g_sub0 <- induced_subgraph(g_all, vids = ego_vids)
msg_counts("g_sub0 (ego induced)", g_sub0)

if (ecount(g_sub0) == 0) {
  stop("g_sub0 has 0 edges. TF likely has no outgoing edges after filtering. Lower min_edge_weight.")
}

# --- Recompute layers with safe name mapping ---
dmat <- distances(g_sub0, v = tf_of_interest, to = V(g_sub0), mode = "out")
layer_vec <- as.numeric(dmat[1, ])
names(layer_vec) <- colnames(dmat)

# attach layers by vertex name (robust to ordering)
V(g_sub0)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub0)$name]

# keep nodes within max_steps
keep_nodes <- V(g_sub0)$name[is.finite(V(g_sub0)$layer) & V(g_sub0)$layer <= max_steps]
g_sub <- induced_subgraph(g_sub0, vids = keep_nodes)
V(g_sub)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub)$name]

message("Layer counts in g_sub:")
print(table(V(g_sub)$layer, useNA = "ifany"))

# --- Outward-edge filter (robust) ---
if (isTRUE(keep_outward_edges)) {
  edf <- as_data_frame(g_sub, what = "edges") %>%
    rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
    mutate(
      layer_u = layer_vec[source],
      layer_v = layer_vec[target]
    )

  # diagnostic: show a few edges with their layers
  message("Example edges with layers (first 10):")
  print(head(edf %>% select(source, target, layer_u, layer_v, weight), 10))

  # Keep edges that move outward (layer increases), within max_steps
  edf2 <- edf %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(layer_u), is.finite(layer_v),
      layer_u < layer_v,            # outward (more robust than layer_u + 1 == layer_v)
      layer_v <= max_steps
    ) %>%
    select(source, target, weight)

  if (nrow(edf2) == 0) {
    stop("Outward-edge filter removed all edges even with layer_u < layer_v. ",
         "Try keep_outward_edges=FALSE or lower min_edge_weight.")
  }

  g_sub <- graph_from_data_frame(
    edf2,
    directed = TRUE,
    vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(edf2$source, edf2$target)))
  )
  V(g_sub)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub)$name]
  E(g_sub)$weight <- edf2$weight
  message("g_sub after outward-edge filter: nodes=", vcount(g_sub), " edges=", ecount(g_sub))
}

if (!(tf_of_interest %in% V(g_sub)$name)) stop("TF missing after subgraph filtering; unexpected.")

# ----------------------------
# Node annotations
# ----------------------------
nodes_df <- tibble(name = V(g_sub)$name) %>%
  mutate(
    layer = V(g_sub)$layer,
    is_center = name == tf_of_interest,
    is_tf = name %in% tf_universe,
    node_type = if_else(is_tf, "TF", "Gene")
  ) %>%
  left_join(de2, by = c("name" = "gene_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_deseq = !is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(padj),
    is_DE = dplyr::coalesce(is_DE, FALSE),
    # If centre TF not in DE table, set neutral logFC
    log2FoldChange = if_else(is_center & !has_deseq, 0, log2FoldChange),
    has_deseq = if_else(is_center, TRUE, has_deseq)
  )

edges_df <- as_data_frame(g_sub, what = "edges") %>%
  rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

if (nrow(edges_df) == 0) stop("edges_df has 0 rows (no edges) after subgraph filtering.")

# Incoming max per target, robust to all-NA
incoming_gene <- edges_df %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  summarise(max_incoming = max(abs_weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(max_incoming = ifelse(is.infinite(max_incoming), 0, max_incoming))

nodes_df <- nodes_df %>%
  left_join(incoming_gene, by = c("name" = "target")) %>%
  mutate(max_incoming = if_else(is.na(max_incoming), 0, max_incoming))

# Extra non-DE genes to include (grey)
extra_nonDE_genes <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(add_top_nonDE_genes)) {
  extra_nonDE_genes <- nodes_df %>%
    filter(node_type == "Gene", has_deseq, !is_DE) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_incoming)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top_nonDE_genes) %>%
    pull(name)
}

# Extra unmatched genes to include (grey)
extra_unmatched_genes <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(include_unmatched_genes)) {
  extra_unmatched_genes <- nodes_df %>%
    filter(node_type == "Gene", !has_deseq) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_incoming)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_unmatched_genes) %>%
    pull(name)
}

message("Nodes classified as TF in subgraph: ", sum(nodes_df$is_tf))
message("Nodes that appear as sources in subgraph but are NOT classified as TF: ",
        sum(nodes_df$name %in% edges_df$source & !nodes_df$is_tf))

keep_final_nodes <- nodes_df %>%
  filter(
    is_tf |
      (node_type == "Gene" & is_DE) |
      (node_type == "Gene" & name %in% extra_nonDE_genes) |
      (node_type == "Gene" & name %in% extra_unmatched_genes)
  ) %>%
  pull(name) %>%
  unique()

g_final <- induced_subgraph(g_sub, vids = keep_final_nodes)
msg_counts("g_final (after keeping TFs + DE + extras)", g_final)

if (ecount(g_final) == 0) {
  stop("g_final has 0 edges after node selection. Increase extras, lower thresholds, or disable keep_outward_edges.")
}

# Re-derive nodes_df_final from nodes_df and attach vertex attributes
nodes_df_final <- nodes_df %>% filter(name %in% V(g_final)$name)

V(g_final)$layer         <- nodes_df_final$layer[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$is_center     <- nodes_df_final$is_center[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$is_tf         <- nodes_df_final$is_tf[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$node_type     <- nodes_df_final$node_type[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$has_deseq     <- nodes_df_final$has_deseq[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$is_DE         <- nodes_df_final$is_DE[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$log2FoldChange<- nodes_df_final$log2FoldChange[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$abs_lfc       <- nodes_df_final$abs_lfc[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]

# Shapes and sizes
V(g_final)$shape <- ifelse(V(g_final)$node_type == "TF", tf_shape, gene_shape)
V(g_final)$size  <- ifelse(V(g_final)$is_center, 13,
                           ifelse(V(g_final)$node_type == "TF", 9, 7))

# ----------------------------
# Labels: TFs + top DE genes by abs_lfc
# ----------------------------
plot_label <- rep(NA_character_, vcount(g_final))
names(plot_label) <- V(g_final)$name

if (isTRUE(label_tfs)) {
  tf_names <- V(g_final)$name[V(g_final)$node_type == "TF"]
  plot_label[tf_names] <- tf_names
}

if (isTRUE(label_top_de_genes)) {
  de_gene_names <- V(g_final)$name[V(g_final)$node_type == "Gene" & V(g_final)$is_DE %in% TRUE]
  abs_lfc_vec <- V(g_final)$abs_lfc
  abs_lfc_vec[is.na(abs_lfc_vec)] <- 0
  ord <- order(abs_lfc_vec[match(de_gene_names, V(g_final)$name)], decreasing = TRUE)
  top_genes <- head(de_gene_names[ord], n_label_de_genes)
  plot_label[top_genes] <- top_genes
}

V(g_final)$plot_label <- unname(plot_label[V(g_final)$name])

# ----------------------------
# Edge widths
# ----------------------------
edf_final <- as_data_frame(g_final, what = "edges") %>%
  rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

if (nrow(edf_final) == 0) stop("edf_final has 0 edges; cannot compute edge widths.")

# Lookup TF1->X weights (for path2 proxy)
tf1_out <- edf_final %>%
  filter(source == tf_of_interest) %>%
  select(target, w_tf1 = abs_weight) %>%
  distinct()

if (tolower(edge_width_mode) == "path2") {
  # For each edge (u->v), if u is not TF1, try to multiply by TF1->u weight
  edf_final <- edf_final %>%
    left_join(tf1_out, by = c("source" = "target")) %>%
    mutate(
      width_raw = case_when(
        source == tf_of_interest ~ abs_weight,
        !is.na(w_tf1)            ~ abs_weight * w_tf1,
        TRUE                     ~ abs_weight
      ),
      width_raw = ifelse(is.na(width_raw), abs_weight, width_raw)
    )
} else {
  edf_final <- edf_final %>% mutate(width_raw = abs_weight)
}

if (all(is.na(edf_final$width_raw))) stop("All width_raw are NA; cannot rescale widths.")

edf_final <- edf_final %>%
  mutate(edge_width = rescale(width_raw, to = edge_width_range))

# ----------------------------
# Rebuild graph with edge_width as an edge attribute
# (IMPORTANT: carry vertex attributes correctly via vertices= dataframe)
# ----------------------------
vdf <- tibble(
  name           = V(g_final)$name,
  layer          = V(g_final)$layer,
  is_center      = V(g_final)$is_center,
  is_tf          = V(g_final)$is_tf,
  node_type      = V(g_final)$node_type,
  has_deseq      = V(g_final)$has_deseq,
  is_DE          = V(g_final)$is_DE,
  log2FoldChange = V(g_final)$log2FoldChange,
  abs_lfc        = V(g_final)$abs_lfc,
  shape          = V(g_final)$shape,
  size           = V(g_final)$size,
  plot_label     = V(g_final)$plot_label
)

g_final2 <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edf_final %>% transmute(from = source, to = target, weight, width_raw, edge_width),
  directed = TRUE,
  vertices = vdf
)

msg_counts("g_final2 (final graph)", g_final2)

if (ecount(g_final2) == 0) stop("g_final2 has 0 edges after rebuild; unexpected.")

# ----------------------------
# Layout: Sugiyama (layered) fallback FR, then recenter TF1
# ----------------------------
layers_vec <- V(g_final2)$layer
names(layers_vec) <- V(g_final2)$name

coords <- tryCatch({
  sug <- layout_with_sugiyama(g_final2, layers = layers_vec)
  sug$layout
}, error = function(e) {
  message("layout_with_sugiyama failed (", conditionMessage(e), "). Falling back to layout_with_fr().")
  layout_with_fr(g_final2)
})

center_idx <- which(V(g_final2)$name == tf_of_interest)
if (length(center_idx) != 1) stop("centre TF not uniquely present in g_final2; check node names.")
coords <- sweep(coords, 2, coords[center_idx, ], FUN = "-")

# Drop isolated nodes
iso <- V(g_final2)[degree(g_final2, mode = "all") == 0]
if (length(iso) > 0) {
  message("Dropping isolated vertices: ", length(iso))
  g_final2 <- delete_vertices(g_final2, iso)
}

library(grid)
# --- Compute influence-related summary metrics for the TF of interest ---

# direct targets (1 step) and total reachable targets (<=2 steps) in the displayed graph
dist_vec <- distances(g_final2, v = tf_of_interest, to = V(g_final2), mode = "out")
dist_vec <- as.numeric(dist_vec[1, ])
names(dist_vec) <- colnames(distances(g_final2, v = tf_of_interest, to = V(g_final2), mode = "out"))

direct_targets_n <- sum(dist_vec == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
secondary_targets_n <- sum(dist_vec == 2, na.rm = TRUE)

# DE genes reachable (as ANANSE targetscore uses only DE genes)
de_genes_reachable <- V(g_final2)$name[V(g_final2)$node_type == "Gene" & V(g_final2)$is_DE %in% TRUE &
                                        is.finite(dist_vec[V(g_final2)$name])]

# Target-score proxy (matches your DE table scoring):
# sum over reachable DE genes of abs(log2FC) * (padj<cutoff) * (path/edge weight proxy)
# Here we use a *simple* approximation: sum(abs_lfc * max incoming width_raw from TF-subgraph).
# (If you later replicate dijkstra_prob_length exactly, swap this out.)
edge_tbl <- as_data_frame(g_final2, what = "edges") %>%
  rename(source = from, target = to)

# For each gene, use max width_raw among incoming edges in the plotted subnet
gene_incoming <- edge_tbl %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  summarise(max_width_raw = max(width_raw, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(max_width_raw = ifelse(is.infinite(max_width_raw), 0, max_width_raw))

targetscore_proxy <- tibble(gene = de_genes_reachable) %>%
  left_join(
    tibble(gene = V(g_final2)$name,
           abs_lfc = V(g_final2)$abs_lfc,
           is_DE = V(g_final2)$is_DE,
           log2fc = V(g_final2)$log2FoldChange),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(gene_incoming, by = c("gene" = "target")) %>%
  mutate(abs_lfc = ifelse(is.na(abs_lfc), 0, abs_lfc),
         max_width_raw = ifelse(is.na(max_width_raw), 0, max_width_raw)) %>%
  summarise(score = sum(abs_lfc * max_width_raw, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(score)

# G_score (as per ANANSE code): abs(log2FC_TF) if TF padj<cutoff else 0
tf_log2fc <- nodes_df_final$log2FoldChange[nodes_df_final$name == tf_of_interest]
tf_padj   <- nodes_df_final$padj[nodes_df_final$name == tf_of_interest]
G_score <- ifelse(!is.na(tf_padj) && tf_padj <= padj_cutoff, abs(tf_log2fc), 0)

# Influence raw proxy
influence_raw_proxy <- targetscore_proxy + G_score

summary_lines <- c(
  paste0("TF: ", tf_of_interest),
  paste0("Direct targets (1-step): ", direct_targets_n),
  paste0("Secondary targets (2-step): ", secondary_targets_n),
  paste0("DE genes reachable: ", length(de_genes_reachable)),
  paste0("Target score (proxy): ", signif(targetscore_proxy, 4)),
  paste0("G score: ", signif(G_score, 4)),
  paste0("TF log2FC: ", signif(tf_log2fc, 4)),
  paste0("Influence raw (proxy): ", signif(influence_raw_proxy, 4))
)


# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------
p <- ggraph(g_final2, layout = "manual", x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2]) +

  geom_edge_link(
    aes(width = edge_width),
    colour = edge_col,
    alpha = edge_alpha,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(arrow_mm, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    end_cap = circle(2.4, "mm")
  ) +
  scale_edge_width_identity() +

  # non-DE matched genes (grey)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "Gene", has_deseq, !is_DE),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = nonDE_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +

  # unmatched genes (grey85)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "Gene", !has_deseq),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = unmatched_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +

  # TFs + DE genes (directional log2FC)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "TF" | is_DE),
    aes(fill = log2FoldChange, size = size, shape = shape),
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  scale_shape_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = fc_low, mid = fc_mid, high = fc_high,
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "log2FC\n(Old vs Young)"
  ) +

  # Labels
  geom_node_label(
    aes(label = plot_label),
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, !is.na(plot_label)),
    nudge_x = label_nudge_x,
    nudge_y = label_nudge_y,
    hjust = label_hjust,
    vjust = label_vjust,
    fill = scales::alpha(label_fill_col, label_fill_alpha),
    colour = label_text_col,
    label.size = label_border_size,
    label.padding = unit(label_box_padding_lines, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(label_box_radius_lines, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  theme_void() +
  ggtitle(paste0(
    "2-step branching subnet around ", tf_of_interest,
    " | minEdge≥", min_edge_weight,
    " | DE: padj≤", padj_cutoff,
    if (add_top_nonDE_genes) paste0(" | +", n_top_nonDE_genes, " non-DE genes") else "",
    if (include_unmatched_genes) paste0(" | +", n_unmatched_genes, " unmatched") else "",
    " | outwardEdges=", keep_outward_edges,
    " | edgeWidth=", edge_width_mode
  )) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p <- p + annotation_custom(
  grob = grid::textGrob(
    label = paste(summary_lines, collapse = "\n"),
    x = unit(0.98, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"),
    just = c("right", "bottom"),
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
  )
)

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------
ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = out_width, height = out_height, device = cairo_pdf)
message("Saved plot to: ", out_pdf)

if (interactive()) print(p)
```

```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(units)
  library(Cairo)
  library(grid)
  library(patchwork)
})

# ============================================================
# 2-step branching subnet plot for ANANSE influence intuition
#
# - Uses UNFILTERED diffnetwork for TABLE counts (true ANANSE diffnetwork)
# - Uses FILTERED diffnetwork for PLOT (min_edge_weight)
# - Builds outward ego graph (radius=max_steps) around tf_of_interest
# - Optional outward-edge filter for plotting graph (layer_u < layer_v)
# - TF nodes squares; gene nodes circles
# - Node fill is directional log2FC (blue-white-red)
# - Edge width is either direct edge or 2-step proxy (path2)
# - Adds:
#     (1) edge-width legend (via scale_edge_width)
#     (2) right-side info panel (outside plot border) BELOW the log2FC legend
#         showing scaled ANANSE scores + true 2-step neighbourhood counts
#
# Notes on scores:
# - ANANSE influence_score_raw = target_score + G_score (raw)
# - ANANSE influence_score (scaled 0-1) comes from rank/minmax on
#   target_score_scaled + G_score_scaled.
#   In this script, we display the scaled values as requested.
# ============================================================

# ----------------------------
# Input files
# ----------------------------
influence_file <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence.txt"

diffnet_file   <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence_diffnetwork.tsv"

deseq_file     <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_nfcore_tfactivity/tfactivity_results/HSC_50kbp_window_JASPAR2024_all_vert_motifs_Old_over_Young/01_counts/05_deseq2/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC.deseq2.results.tsv"


# ----------------------------
# User knobs
# ----------------------------
tf_of_interest <- "MAF"
max_steps <- 2

# PLOT edge filter only (table uses the unfiltered diffnetwork)
min_edge_weight <- 0.01

# DE definition (used for node colouring; also used for "DE genes reachable (strict)" count)
padj_cutoff    <- 0.05
abs_lfc_cutoff <- 0.25

# Densify plot (optional)
add_top_nonDE_genes <- FALSE
n_top_nonDE_genes   <- 40

include_unmatched_genes <- FALSE
n_unmatched_genes       <- 25

# Branching structure
keep_outward_edges <- TRUE

# Edge width definition:
#  "edge"  = direct edge weight
#  "path2" = for non-TF1 edges, width_raw ~ w(TF1->source) * w(source->target) if TF1->source exists
edge_width_mode <- "path2"

# Aesthetics
tf_shape    <- 22
gene_shape  <- 21
node_border <- "grey85"

edge_col   <- "grey10"
edge_alpha <- 1
edge_width_range <- c(0.4, 2.2)
arrow_mm   <- 2.3

nonDE_fill     <- "grey70"
unmatched_fill <- "grey85"

fc_low  <- "blue3"
fc_mid  <- "white"
fc_high <- "red3"

# Labels
label_tfs <- TRUE
label_top_de_genes <- TRUE
n_label_de_genes <- 25

label_nudge_x <- 0.00
label_nudge_y <- 0.1
label_hjust   <- 0.5
label_vjust   <- -1
label_box_padding_lines <- 0.12
label_box_radius_lines  <- 0.12
label_fill_col   <- "white"
label_fill_alpha <- 0.50
label_text_col   <- "black"
label_border_size <- 0.0

# Output
out_dir <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/GRN_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
out_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("ANANSE_2step_branch_", tf_of_interest, "_Young2Old.pdf"))
out_width <- 12
out_height <- 9


# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing <- function(path) if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)

msg_counts <- function(label, g) {
  message(label, ": nodes=", vcount(g), " edges=", ecount(g))
}

# ----------------------------
# Load
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing(influence_file)
stop_if_missing(diffnet_file)
stop_if_missing(deseq_file)

inf <- read_tsv(influence_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA"))
if (!("factor" %in% colnames(inf))) stop("Influence file missing column 'factor'.")

diffnet_full <- read_tsv(diffnet_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
  select(source, target, weight) %>%
  filter(!is.na(source), !is.na(target), !is.na(weight))

if (nrow(diffnet_full) == 0) stop("diffnet_full is empty after reading.")

# filtered copy for plotting only
diffnet_plot <- diffnet_full %>% filter(weight >= min_edge_weight)
if (nrow(diffnet_plot) == 0) stop("No edges after min_edge_weight filtering; lower min_edge_weight.")

# TF universe: all scored TFs + all sources in the diffnetwork
tf_universe <- union(unique(inf$factor), unique(diffnet_full$source))
if (!(tf_of_interest %in% tf_universe)) stop("tf_of_interest not found in TF universe: ", tf_of_interest)

de <- read_tsv(deseq_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
  select(gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj)

de2 <- de %>%
  mutate(
    abs_lfc = abs(log2FoldChange),
    is_DE_strict = !is.na(padj) & !is.na(log2FoldChange) & (padj <= padj_cutoff) & (abs_lfc >= abs_lfc_cutoff),
    is_DE_padj   = !is.na(padj) & (padj <= padj_cutoff)
  )

# ----------------------------
# TABLE metrics from TRUE ANANSE diffnetwork (unfiltered)
# ----------------------------
g_all_table <- graph_from_data_frame(diffnet_full, directed = TRUE)
E(g_all_table)$weight <- diffnet_full$weight

if (!(tf_of_interest %in% V(g_all_table)$name)) {
  stop("TF not found in unfiltered diffnetwork graph (table graph): ", tf_of_interest)
}

# Ego graph within max_steps on the true network
ego_tbl_vids <- ego(g_all_table, order = max_steps, nodes = tf_of_interest, mode = "out")[[1]]
g_tbl0 <- induced_subgraph(g_all_table, vids = ego_tbl_vids)

# hop distances (unweighted) for layer counts
dmat_tbl <- distances(g_tbl0, v = tf_of_interest, to = V(g_tbl0), mode = "out")
layer_tbl <- as.numeric(dmat_tbl[1, ])
names(layer_tbl) <- colnames(dmat_tbl)

# total primary/secondary nodes (all node types)
tbl_direct_targets_total    <- sum(layer_tbl == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
tbl_secondary_targets_total <- sum(layer_tbl == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
tbl_targets_within2_total   <- sum(is.finite(layer_tbl) & layer_tbl >= 1 & layer_tbl <= max_steps, na.rm = TRUE)

# DE genes reachable (strict and padj-only), based on DE table overlap with ego nodes
ego_tbl_nodes <- names(layer_tbl)[is.finite(layer_tbl) & layer_tbl >= 1 & layer_tbl <= max_steps]

tbl_de_strict <- de2 %>% filter(gene_id %in% ego_tbl_nodes, is_DE_strict) %>% nrow()
tbl_de_padj   <- de2 %>% filter(gene_id %in% ego_tbl_nodes, is_DE_padj)   %>% nrow()

# Pull ANANSE scores for the TF (scaled)
tf_inf <- inf %>% filter(factor == tf_of_interest) %>% slice(1)
if (nrow(tf_inf) == 0) stop("TF not found in influence table: ", tf_of_interest)

# ----------------------------
# PLOT graph from FILTERED diffnetwork
# ----------------------------
g_all <- graph_from_data_frame(diffnet_plot, directed = TRUE)
E(g_all)$weight <- diffnet_plot$weight
msg_counts("g_all (plot graph, filtered)", g_all)

if (!(tf_of_interest %in% V(g_all)$name)) {
  stop("TF not found as a node in filtered plot graph. Lower min_edge_weight or use unfiltered for plotting.")
}

# Ego graph (outward) within max_steps on plot graph
ego_vids <- ego(g_all, order = max_steps, nodes = tf_of_interest, mode = "out")[[1]]
g_sub0 <- induced_subgraph(g_all, vids = ego_vids)
msg_counts("g_sub0 (plot ego induced)", g_sub0)

if (ecount(g_sub0) == 0) stop("g_sub0 has 0 edges; lower min_edge_weight.")

# Layers with safe name mapping (plot graph)
dmat <- distances(g_sub0, v = tf_of_interest, to = V(g_sub0), mode = "out")
layer_vec <- as.numeric(dmat[1, ])
names(layer_vec) <- colnames(dmat)
V(g_sub0)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub0)$name]

keep_nodes <- V(g_sub0)$name[is.finite(V(g_sub0)$layer) & V(g_sub0)$layer <= max_steps]
g_sub <- induced_subgraph(g_sub0, vids = keep_nodes)
V(g_sub)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub)$name]

message("Layer counts in g_sub (plot graph):")
print(table(V(g_sub)$layer, useNA = "ifany"))

# Outward-edge filter for plot structure
if (isTRUE(keep_outward_edges)) {
  edf <- as_data_frame(g_sub, what = "edges") %>%
    rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
    mutate(
      layer_u = layer_vec[source],
      layer_v = layer_vec[target]
    )

  edf2 <- edf %>%
    filter(is.finite(layer_u), is.finite(layer_v),
           layer_u < layer_v,
           layer_v <= max_steps) %>%
    select(source, target, weight)

  if (nrow(edf2) == 0) stop("Outward-edge filter removed all edges. Set keep_outward_edges=FALSE or lower min_edge_weight.")

  g_sub <- graph_from_data_frame(
    edf2,
    directed = TRUE,
    vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(edf2$source, edf2$target)))
  )
  V(g_sub)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub)$name]
  E(g_sub)$weight <- edf2$weight
  msg_counts("g_sub (after outward-edge filter)", g_sub)
}

# ----------------------------
# Node annotations (plot graph)
# ----------------------------
nodes_df <- tibble(name = V(g_sub)$name) %>%
  mutate(
    layer = V(g_sub)$layer,
    is_center = name == tf_of_interest,
    is_tf = name %in% tf_universe,
    node_type = if_else(is_tf, "TF", "Gene")
  ) %>%
  left_join(de2, by = c("name" = "gene_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_deseq = !is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(padj),
    is_DE = dplyr::coalesce(is_DE_strict, FALSE),
    log2FoldChange = if_else(is_center & !has_deseq, 0, log2FoldChange),
    has_deseq = if_else(is_center, TRUE, has_deseq)
  )

edges_df <- as_data_frame(g_sub, what = "edges") %>%
  rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

incoming_gene <- edges_df %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  summarise(max_incoming = max(abs_weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(max_incoming = ifelse(is.infinite(max_incoming), 0, max_incoming))

nodes_df <- nodes_df %>%
  left_join(incoming_gene, by = c("name" = "target")) %>%
  mutate(max_incoming = if_else(is.na(max_incoming), 0, max_incoming))

extra_nonDE_genes <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(add_top_nonDE_genes)) {
  extra_nonDE_genes <- nodes_df %>%
    filter(node_type == "Gene", has_deseq, !is_DE) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_incoming)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top_nonDE_genes) %>%
    pull(name)
}

extra_unmatched_genes <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(include_unmatched_genes)) {
  extra_unmatched_genes <- nodes_df %>%
    filter(node_type == "Gene", !has_deseq) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_incoming)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_unmatched_genes) %>%
    pull(name)
}

keep_final_nodes <- nodes_df %>%
  filter(
    is_tf |
      (node_type == "Gene" & is_DE) |
      (node_type == "Gene" & name %in% extra_nonDE_genes) |
      (node_type == "Gene" & name %in% extra_unmatched_genes)
  ) %>%
  pull(name) %>%
  unique()

g_final <- induced_subgraph(g_sub, vids = keep_final_nodes)
msg_counts("g_final (plot, after keeping TFs + DE + extras)", g_final)
if (ecount(g_final) == 0) stop("g_final has 0 edges; relax filters or disable outward edges.")

# Attach vertex attrs
nodes_df_final <- nodes_df %>% filter(name %in% V(g_final)$name)

V(g_final)$layer          <- nodes_df_final$layer[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$is_center      <- nodes_df_final$is_center[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$node_type      <- nodes_df_final$node_type[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$has_deseq      <- nodes_df_final$has_deseq[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$is_DE          <- nodes_df_final$is_DE[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$log2FoldChange <- nodes_df_final$log2FoldChange[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$abs_lfc        <- nodes_df_final$abs_lfc[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]

V(g_final)$shape <- ifelse(V(g_final)$node_type == "TF", tf_shape, gene_shape)
V(g_final)$size  <- ifelse(V(g_final)$is_center, 13,
                           ifelse(V(g_final)$node_type == "TF", 9, 7))

# Labels: TFs + top DE genes by abs_lfc
plot_label <- rep(NA_character_, vcount(g_final))
names(plot_label) <- V(g_final)$name

if (isTRUE(label_tfs)) {
  tf_names <- V(g_final)$name[V(g_final)$node_type == "TF"]
  plot_label[tf_names] <- tf_names
}
if (isTRUE(label_top_de_genes)) {
  de_gene_names <- V(g_final)$name[V(g_final)$node_type == "Gene" & V(g_final)$is_DE %in% TRUE]
  abs_lfc_vec <- V(g_final)$abs_lfc
  abs_lfc_vec[is.na(abs_lfc_vec)] <- 0
  ord <- order(abs_lfc_vec[match(de_gene_names, V(g_final)$name)], decreasing = TRUE)
  top_genes <- head(de_gene_names[ord], n_label_de_genes)
  plot_label[top_genes] <- top_genes
}
V(g_final)$plot_label <- unname(plot_label[V(g_final)$name])

# Edge widths
edf_final <- as_data_frame(g_final, what = "edges") %>%
  rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

# TF1->X lookup
tf1_out <- edf_final %>%
  filter(source == tf_of_interest) %>%
  select(target, w_tf1 = abs_weight) %>%
  distinct()

if (tolower(edge_width_mode) == "path2") {
  edf_final <- edf_final %>%
    left_join(tf1_out, by = c("source" = "target")) %>%
    mutate(
      width_raw = case_when(
        source == tf_of_interest ~ abs_weight,
        !is.na(w_tf1)            ~ abs_weight * w_tf1,
        TRUE                     ~ abs_weight
      ),
      width_raw = ifelse(is.na(width_raw), abs_weight, width_raw)
    )
} else {
  edf_final <- edf_final %>% mutate(width_raw = abs_weight)
}

edf_final <- edf_final %>% mutate(edge_width = rescale(width_raw, to = edge_width_range))

# Rebuild final plot graph with edge attributes + vertex attributes
vdf <- tibble(
  name           = V(g_final)$name,
  layer          = V(g_final)$layer,
  is_center      = V(g_final)$is_center,
  node_type      = V(g_final)$node_type,
  has_deseq      = V(g_final)$has_deseq,
  is_DE          = V(g_final)$is_DE,
  log2FoldChange = V(g_final)$log2FoldChange,
  abs_lfc        = V(g_final)$abs_lfc,
  shape          = V(g_final)$shape,
  size           = V(g_final)$size,
  plot_label     = V(g_final)$plot_label
)

g_final2 <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edf_final %>% transmute(from = source, to = target, weight, width_raw),
  directed = TRUE,
  vertices = vdf
)

# Layout
layers_vec <- V(g_final2)$layer
names(layers_vec) <- V(g_final2)$name

coords <- tryCatch({
  sug <- layout_with_sugiyama(g_final2, layers = layers_vec)
  sug$layout
}, error = function(e) {
  message("layout_with_sugiyama failed (", conditionMessage(e), "). Falling back to layout_with_fr().")
  layout_with_fr(g_final2)
})

center_idx <- which(V(g_final2)$name == tf_of_interest)
coords <- sweep(coords, 2, coords[center_idx, ], FUN = "-")

# Drop isolated nodes
iso <- V(g_final2)[degree(g_final2, mode = "all") == 0]
if (length(iso) > 0) g_final2 <- delete_vertices(g_final2, iso)

# ----------------------------
# Build RIGHT-SIDE TABLE panel (outside plot border)
# (Use scaled values as requested)
# ----------------------------
summary_lines <- c(
  paste0("TF: ", tf_of_interest),
  paste0("Direct targets (1-step, total): ", tbl_direct_targets_total),
  paste0("Secondary targets (2-step, total): ", tbl_secondary_targets_total),
  paste0("Targets within ", max_steps, " steps (total): ", tbl_targets_within2_total),
  paste0("DE genes reachable (padj & absLFC≥", abs_lfc_cutoff, "): ", tbl_de_strict),
  paste0("DE genes reachable (padj only): ", tbl_de_padj),
  "",
  paste0("target_score_scaled: ", signif(tf_inf$target_score_scaled, 4)),
  paste0("G_score_scaled: ", signif(tf_inf$G_score_scaled, 4)),
  paste0("influence_score (scaled): ", signif(tf_inf$influence_score, 4))
)

table_grob <- grobTree(
  rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = alpha("white", 0.0), col = NA)),  # borderless
  textGrob(
    label = paste(summary_lines, collapse = "\n"),
    x = unit(0, "npc"), y = unit(1, "npc"),
    just = c("left", "top"),
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
  )
)

p_table <- ggplot() +
  theme_void() +
  annotation_custom(table_grob, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)

# ----------------------------
# Plot (main)
# ----------------------------
p_main <- ggraph(g_final2, layout = "manual", x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2]) +

  # Edges (width legend uses raw widths)
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = width_raw),
    colour = edge_col,
    alpha = edge_alpha,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(arrow_mm, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    end_cap = circle(2.4, "mm"),
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_edge_width(
    range = edge_width_range,
    breaks = function(x) pretty(x, n = 5),
    name = "Edge weight"
  ) +

  # non-DE matched genes (grey)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "Gene", has_deseq, !is_DE),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = nonDE_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +

  # unmatched genes (grey85)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "Gene", !has_deseq),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = unmatched_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +

  # TFs + DE genes (directional log2FC)
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "TF" | is_DE),
    aes(fill = log2FoldChange, size = size, shape = shape),
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  scale_shape_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = fc_low, mid = fc_mid, high = fc_high,
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = fc_limits,
    breaks = fc_breaks,                # optional
    oob = scales::squish,              # keeps out-of-range values at the ends
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "log2FC\n(Old vs Young)"
  ) +

  # Labels
  geom_node_label(
    aes(label = plot_label),
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, !is.na(plot_label)),
    nudge_x = label_nudge_x,
    nudge_y = label_nudge_y,
    hjust = label_hjust,
    vjust = label_vjust,
    fill = scales::alpha(label_fill_col, label_fill_alpha),
    colour = label_text_col,
    label.size = label_border_size,
    label.padding = unit(label_box_padding_lines, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(label_box_radius_lines, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  theme_void() +
  ggtitle(paste0(
    "2-step branching subnet around ", tf_of_interest,
    " | plot minEdge≥", min_edge_weight,
    " | DE: padj≤", padj_cutoff, ", absLFC≥", abs_lfc_cutoff,
    " | outwardEdges=", keep_outward_edges,
    " | edgeWidth=", edge_width_mode
  )) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

# Stack the table under the legends by placing it in a right-side column.
# The legends live on p_main (right side). We'll give the table its own right column
# and align heights using patchwork.
final_plot <- p_main | p_table +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.33))

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------
ggsave(out_pdf, final_plot, width = out_width, height = out_height, device = cairo_pdf)
message("Saved plot to: ", out_pdf)
```

```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(units)
  library(Cairo)
  library(grid)
  library(patchwork)
})

# ----------------------------
# Input files
# ----------------------------
influence_file <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence.txt"

diffnet_file   <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/STARE_YoungHSC_to_OldHSC_TF_influence_diffnetwork.tsv"

deseq_file     <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_nfcore_tfactivity/tfactivity_results/HSC_50kbp_window_JASPAR2024_all_vert_motifs_Old_over_Young/01_counts/05_deseq2/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC/A_Young_HSC:B_Old_HSC.deseq2.results.tsv"


# ----------------------------
# User knobs
# ----------------------------
tf_of_interest <- "KLF4"
max_steps <- 2

# Plot edges only (table uses unfiltered diffnetwork)
min_edge_weight_plot <- 0.01

# DE definition
padj_cutoff    <- 0.05
abs_lfc_cutoff <- 0.25

# Densify plot (optional)
add_top_nonDE_genes <- FALSE
n_top_nonDE_genes   <- 40

include_unmatched_genes <- FALSE
n_unmatched_genes       <- 25

# Branching structure
keep_outward_edges <- TRUE

# Edge width definition
edge_width_mode <- "path2"  # "edge" or "path2"

# Plot layout (THIS is what fixes the 3-row issue)
plot_layout <- "nicely"     # "nicely", "fr", "kk", "circle", "random"
plot_seed <- 1              # reproducible force layouts
tf_y_offset_frac <- 0.20    # move TF a bit upward after centering (0 = centered)

# Aesthetics
tf_shape    <- 22
gene_shape  <- 21
node_border <- "grey85"

edge_col   <- "grey10"
edge_alpha <- 1
edge_width_range <- c(0.4, 2.2)
arrow_mm   <- 2.3

nonDE_fill     <- "grey70"
unmatched_fill <- "grey85"

fc_low  <- "blue3"
fc_mid  <- "white"
fc_high <- "red3"

# Fixed colour scale across plots
fc_limits <- c(-2, 4)     # pick your global min/max (e.g. c(-3, 3))
fc_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 2, 4)   # optional: consistent legend ticks

# Labels
label_tfs <- TRUE
label_top_de_genes <- TRUE
n_label_de_genes <- 25

label_nudge_x <- 0.00
label_nudge_y <- 0.05
label_hjust   <- 0.5
label_vjust   <- -0.25
label_box_padding_lines <- 0.12
label_box_radius_lines  <- 0.12
label_fill_col   <- "white"
label_fill_alpha <- 0.90
label_text_col   <- "black"
label_border_size <- 0.0

# Right-hand table style
table_fontsize <- 10
table_bg_alpha <- 0.0

# Output
out_dir <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE/STARE_output_in_ANANSE_results_100kb_w5000000_m5000000_H13_motifsV2_loess_offsets_CPM/TF_Influence_Young2Old/GRN_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

out_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("ANANSE_2step_branch_", tf_of_interest, "_Young2Old.pdf"))
out_width <- 15
out_height <- 6


# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing <- function(path) if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)

msg_counts <- function(label, g) {
  message(label, ": nodes=", vcount(g), " edges=", ecount(g))
}

# Convert ALL-CAPS symbols to mouse-style Titlecase for DISPLAY ONLY
mouse_case <- function(x) {
  x2 <- as.character(x)
  is_all_caps <- (x2 == toupper(x2)) & grepl("^[A-Z0-9_]+$", x2) & nchar(x2) > 1
  y <- x2
  y[is_all_caps] <- {
    z <- tolower(x2[is_all_caps])
    paste0(toupper(substr(z, 1, 1)), substr(z, 2, nchar(z)))
  }
  y
}

extract_legend_grob <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  idx <- which(vapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name, character(1)) == "guide-box")
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  g$grobs[[idx[1]]]
}

wrap_grob_plot <- function(grob) {
  ggplot() + theme_void() + annotation_custom(grob, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
}

make_table_grob <- function(lines, fontsize = 9, bg_alpha = 0.0) {
  grobTree(
    rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = alpha("white", bg_alpha), col = NA)),
    textGrob(
      label = paste(lines, collapse = "\n"),
      x = unit(0, "npc"), y = unit(1, "npc"),
      just = c("left", "top"),
      gp = gpar(fontsize = fontsize)
    )
  )
}

get_plot_coords <- function(g, layout_name, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  layout_name <- tolower(layout_name)
  if (layout_name == "nicely") return(layout_nicely(g))
  if (layout_name == "fr")     return(layout_with_fr(g))
  if (layout_name == "kk")     return(layout_with_kk(g))
  if (layout_name == "circle") return(layout_in_circle(g))
  if (layout_name == "random") return(layout_randomly(g))
  # fallback
  layout_nicely(g)
}

# ----------------------------
# Load
# ----------------------------
stop_if_missing(influence_file)
stop_if_missing(diffnet_file)
stop_if_missing(deseq_file)

inf <- read_tsv(influence_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA"))
if (!("factor" %in% colnames(inf))) stop("Influence file missing column 'factor'.")

diffnet_full <- read_tsv(diffnet_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
  select(source, target, weight) %>%
  filter(!is.na(source), !is.na(target), !is.na(weight))
if (nrow(diffnet_full) == 0) stop("diffnet_full is empty after reading.")

diffnet_plot <- diffnet_full %>% filter(weight >= min_edge_weight_plot)
if (nrow(diffnet_plot) == 0) stop("No plot edges after min_edge_weight_plot filtering; lower it.")

tf_universe <- union(unique(inf$factor), unique(diffnet_full$source))
if (!(tf_of_interest %in% tf_universe)) stop("tf_of_interest not found in TF universe: ", tf_of_interest)

de <- read_tsv(deseq_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA")) %>%
  select(gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj)

de2 <- de %>%
  mutate(
    abs_lfc = abs(log2FoldChange),
    is_DE_strict = !is.na(padj) & !is.na(log2FoldChange) & (padj <= padj_cutoff) & (abs_lfc >= abs_lfc_cutoff),
    is_DE_padj   = !is.na(padj) & (padj <= padj_cutoff)
  )

tf_inf <- inf %>% filter(factor == tf_of_interest) %>% slice(1)
if (nrow(tf_inf) == 0) stop("TF not found in influence table: ", tf_of_interest)

# ============================================================
# TABLE metrics from TRUE ANANSE diffnetwork (UNFILTERED)
# ============================================================
g_all_table <- graph_from_data_frame(diffnet_full, directed = TRUE)
v_tbl <- match(tf_of_interest, V(g_all_table)$name)
if (is.na(v_tbl)) stop("TF not found in unfiltered diffnetwork graph: ", tf_of_interest)

ego_tbl_vids <- ego(g_all_table, order = max_steps, nodes = v_tbl, mode = "out")[[1]]
g_tbl0 <- induced_subgraph(g_all_table, vids = ego_tbl_vids)

# IMPORTANT: hop distances must be UNWEIGHTED
dmat_tbl <- distances(
  g_tbl0,
  v = match(tf_of_interest, V(g_tbl0)$name),
  to = V(g_tbl0),
  mode = "out",
  weights = NA
)
dist_tbl <- as.numeric(dmat_tbl[1, ])

tbl_direct_targets_total    <- sum(dist_tbl == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
tbl_secondary_targets_total <- sum(dist_tbl == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
tbl_targets_within2_total   <- sum(dist_tbl >= 1 & dist_tbl <= max_steps, na.rm = TRUE)

reachable_tbl_nodes <- V(g_tbl0)$name[dist_tbl >= 1 & dist_tbl <= max_steps]

tbl_de_strict_nodes <- de2 %>% filter(gene_id %in% reachable_tbl_nodes, is_DE_strict) %>% pull(gene_id)
tbl_de_padj_nodes   <- de2 %>% filter(gene_id %in% reachable_tbl_nodes, is_DE_padj)   %>% pull(gene_id)

tbl_de_strict <- length(tbl_de_strict_nodes)
tbl_de_padj   <- length(tbl_de_padj_nodes)

tbl_de_strict_genes_only <- sum(!(tbl_de_strict_nodes %in% tf_universe))
tbl_de_padj_genes_only   <- sum(!(tbl_de_padj_nodes %in% tf_universe))

message("TABLE sanity: out-degree=", degree(g_all_table, v = v_tbl, mode = "out"),
        " | ego nodes=", vcount(g_tbl0), " | ego edges=", ecount(g_tbl0),
        " | direct=", tbl_direct_targets_total, " | secondary=", tbl_secondary_targets_total)

# ============================================================
# PLOT graph from FILTERED diffnetwork
# ============================================================
g_all <- graph_from_data_frame(diffnet_plot, directed = TRUE)
msg_counts("g_all (plot graph, filtered)", g_all)

v_plot <- match(tf_of_interest, V(g_all)$name)
if (is.na(v_plot)) stop("TF not found in filtered plot graph. Lower min_edge_weight_plot.")

ego_vids <- ego(g_all, order = max_steps, nodes = v_plot, mode = "out")[[1]]
g_sub0 <- induced_subgraph(g_all, vids = ego_vids)
msg_counts("g_sub0 (plot ego induced)", g_sub0)
if (ecount(g_sub0) == 0) stop("g_sub0 has 0 edges; lower min_edge_weight_plot.")

# Hop layers (UNWEIGHTED)
dmat <- distances(
  g_sub0,
  v = match(tf_of_interest, V(g_sub0)$name),
  to = V(g_sub0),
  mode = "out",
  weights = NA
)
layer_vec <- as.integer(dmat[1, ])
names(layer_vec) <- V(g_sub0)$name
V(g_sub0)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub0)$name]

keep_nodes <- V(g_sub0)$name[is.finite(V(g_sub0)$layer) & V(g_sub0)$layer <= max_steps]
g_sub <- induced_subgraph(g_sub0, vids = keep_nodes)
V(g_sub)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub)$name]

# Optional outward-edge filter (keeps branching, reduces back-edges)
if (isTRUE(keep_outward_edges)) {
  edf <- as_data_frame(g_sub, what = "edges") %>%
    rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
    mutate(layer_u = layer_vec[source],
           layer_v = layer_vec[target])

  edf2 <- edf %>%
    filter(is.finite(layer_u), is.finite(layer_v),
           layer_u < layer_v,
           layer_v <= max_steps) %>%
    select(source, target, weight)

  if (nrow(edf2) == 0) stop("Outward-edge filter removed all plot edges. Disable keep_outward_edges or lower min_edge_weight_plot.")

  g_sub <- graph_from_data_frame(
    edf2,
    directed = TRUE,
    vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(edf2$source, edf2$target)))
  )
  V(g_sub)$layer <- layer_vec[V(g_sub)$name]
  E(g_sub)$weight <- edf2$weight
  msg_counts("g_sub (after outward-edge filter)", g_sub)
}

# Node annotations (plot graph)
nodes_df <- tibble(name = V(g_sub)$name) %>%
  mutate(
    layer = V(g_sub)$layer,
    is_center = name == tf_of_interest,
    is_tf = name %in% tf_universe,
    node_type = if_else(is_tf, "TF", "Gene")
  ) %>%
  left_join(de2, by = c("name" = "gene_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_deseq = !is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(padj),
    is_DE = dplyr::coalesce(is_DE_strict, FALSE),
    log2FoldChange = if_else(is_center & !has_deseq, 0, log2FoldChange),
    has_deseq = if_else(is_center, TRUE, has_deseq)
  )

edges_df <- as_data_frame(g_sub, what = "edges") %>%
  rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

incoming_gene <- edges_df %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  summarise(max_incoming = max(abs_weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(max_incoming = ifelse(is.infinite(max_incoming), 0, max_incoming))

nodes_df <- nodes_df %>%
  left_join(incoming_gene, by = c("name" = "target")) %>%
  mutate(max_incoming = if_else(is.na(max_incoming), 0, max_incoming))

extra_nonDE_genes <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(add_top_nonDE_genes)) {
  extra_nonDE_genes <- nodes_df %>%
    filter(node_type == "Gene", has_deseq, !is_DE) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_incoming)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top_nonDE_genes) %>%
    pull(name)
}

extra_unmatched_genes <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(include_unmatched_genes)) {
  extra_unmatched_genes <- nodes_df %>%
    filter(node_type == "Gene", !has_deseq) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_incoming)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_unmatched_genes) %>%
    pull(name)
}

keep_final_nodes <- nodes_df %>%
  filter(
    is_tf |
      (node_type == "Gene" & is_DE) |
      (node_type == "Gene" & name %in% extra_nonDE_genes) |
      (node_type == "Gene" & name %in% extra_unmatched_genes)
  ) %>%
  pull(name) %>%
  unique()

g_final <- induced_subgraph(g_sub, vids = keep_final_nodes)
msg_counts("g_final (plot, after keeping TFs + DE + extras)", g_final)
if (ecount(g_final) == 0) stop("g_final has 0 plot edges; relax plot filters.")

# Attach vertex attrs
nodes_df_final <- nodes_df %>% filter(name %in% V(g_final)$name)

V(g_final)$layer          <- nodes_df_final$layer[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$is_center      <- nodes_df_final$is_center[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$node_type      <- nodes_df_final$node_type[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$has_deseq      <- nodes_df_final$has_deseq[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$is_DE          <- nodes_df_final$is_DE[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$log2FoldChange <- nodes_df_final$log2FoldChange[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]
V(g_final)$abs_lfc        <- nodes_df_final$abs_lfc[match(V(g_final)$name, nodes_df_final$name)]

V(g_final)$shape <- ifelse(V(g_final)$node_type == "TF", tf_shape, gene_shape)
V(g_final)$size  <- ifelse(V(g_final)$is_center, 13,
                           ifelse(V(g_final)$node_type == "TF", 9, 7))

# Labels: store DISPLAY labels using mouse_case()
plot_label <- rep(NA_character_, vcount(g_final))
names(plot_label) <- V(g_final)$name

if (isTRUE(label_tfs)) {
  tf_names <- V(g_final)$name[V(g_final)$node_type == "TF"]
  plot_label[tf_names] <- mouse_case(tf_names)
}
if (isTRUE(label_top_de_genes)) {
  de_gene_names <- V(g_final)$name[V(g_final)$node_type == "Gene" & V(g_final)$is_DE %in% TRUE]
  abs_lfc_vec <- V(g_final)$abs_lfc
  abs_lfc_vec[is.na(abs_lfc_vec)] <- 0
  ord <- order(abs_lfc_vec[match(de_gene_names, V(g_final)$name)], decreasing = TRUE)
  top_genes <- head(de_gene_names[ord], n_label_de_genes)
  plot_label[top_genes] <- mouse_case(top_genes)
}
V(g_final)$plot_label <- unname(plot_label[V(g_final)$name])

# Edge widths (legend uses width_raw)
edf_final <- as_data_frame(g_final, what = "edges") %>%
  rename(source = from, target = to) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

tf1_out <- edf_final %>%
  filter(source == tf_of_interest) %>%
  select(target, w_tf1 = abs_weight) %>%
  distinct()

if (tolower(edge_width_mode) == "path2") {
  edf_final <- edf_final %>%
    left_join(tf1_out, by = c("source" = "target")) %>%
    mutate(
      width_raw = case_when(
        source == tf_of_interest ~ abs_weight,
        !is.na(w_tf1)            ~ abs_weight * w_tf1,
        TRUE                     ~ abs_weight
      ),
      width_raw = ifelse(is.na(width_raw), abs_weight, width_raw)
    )
} else {
  edf_final <- edf_final %>% mutate(width_raw = abs_weight)
}

# Rebuild plot graph with width_raw + vertex attrs
vdf <- tibble(
  name           = V(g_final)$name,
  layer          = V(g_final)$layer,
  is_center      = V(g_final)$is_center,
  node_type      = V(g_final)$node_type,
  has_deseq      = V(g_final)$has_deseq,
  is_DE          = V(g_final)$is_DE,
  log2FoldChange = V(g_final)$log2FoldChange,
  abs_lfc        = V(g_final)$abs_lfc,
  shape          = V(g_final)$shape,
  size           = V(g_final)$size,
  plot_label     = V(g_final)$plot_label
)

g_final2 <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edf_final %>% transmute(from = source, to = target, weight, width_raw),
  directed = TRUE,
  vertices = vdf
)

# Drop isolated nodes before layout
iso <- V(g_final2)[degree(g_final2, mode = "all") == 0]
if (length(iso) > 0) g_final2 <- delete_vertices(g_final2, iso)

# ---- Force-directed plot layout (fixes the "3 rows" problem) ----
coords <- get_plot_coords(g_final2, plot_layout, seed = plot_seed)

# center TF, then move it slightly upward if requested
center_idx <- match(tf_of_interest, V(g_final2)$name)
coords <- sweep(coords, 2, coords[center_idx, ], FUN = "-")
span_y <- diff(range(coords[,2]))
coords[,2] <- coords[,2] + span_y * tf_y_offset_frac

# ----------------------------
# Build plot with legends (for extraction)
# ----------------------------
p_with_legends <- ggraph(g_final2, layout = "manual", x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2]) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = width_raw),
    colour = edge_col,
    alpha = edge_alpha,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(arrow_mm, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    end_cap = circle(2.4, "mm"),
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_edge_width(
    range = edge_width_range,
    breaks = function(x) pretty(x, n = 5),
    name = "Edge weight"
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "Gene", has_deseq, !is_DE),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = nonDE_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "Gene", !has_deseq),
    aes(size = size, shape = shape),
    fill = unmatched_fill,
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, node_type == "TF" | is_DE),
    aes(fill = log2FoldChange, size = size, shape = shape),
    colour = node_border,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  scale_shape_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = fc_low, mid = fc_mid, high = fc_high,
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = fc_limits,
    breaks = fc_breaks,                # optional
    oob = scales::squish,              # keeps out-of-range values at the ends
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "log2FC\n(Old vs Young)"
  ) +
  geom_node_label(
    aes(label = plot_label),
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, !is.na(plot_label)),
    nudge_x = label_nudge_x,
    nudge_y = label_nudge_y,
    hjust = label_hjust,
    vjust = label_vjust,
    fill = scales::alpha(label_fill_col, label_fill_alpha),
    colour = label_text_col,
    label.size = label_border_size,
    label.padding = unit(label_box_padding_lines, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(label_box_radius_lines, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle(paste0(
    "2-step branching subnet around ", mouse_case(tf_of_interest),
    " | plot minEdge≥", min_edge_weight_plot,
    " | DE: padj≤", padj_cutoff, ", absLFC≥", abs_lfc_cutoff,
    " | outwardEdges=", keep_outward_edges,
    " | edgeWidth=", edge_width_mode,
    " | layout=", plot_layout
  )) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

legend_grob <- extract_legend_grob(p_with_legends)
if (is.null(legend_grob)) stop("Could not extract legend grob; unexpected.")

p_main <- p_with_legends + theme(legend.position = "none")

# ----------------------------
# Right-side table (scaled values requested)
# ----------------------------
summary_lines <- c(
  paste0("TF: ", mouse_case(tf_of_interest)),
  paste0("Direct targets (1-step, total): ", tbl_direct_targets_total),
  paste0("Secondary targets (2-step, total): ", tbl_secondary_targets_total),
  paste0("Targets within ", max_steps, " steps (total): ", tbl_targets_within2_total),
  paste0("DE reachable (padj & absLFC≥", abs_lfc_cutoff, "): ", tbl_de_strict,
         "  (genes-only: ", tbl_de_strict_genes_only, ")"),
  paste0("DE reachable (padj only): ", tbl_de_padj,
         "  (genes-only: ", tbl_de_padj_genes_only, ")"),
  "",
  paste0("target_score_scaled: ", signif(tf_inf$target_score_scaled, 4)),
  paste0("G_score_scaled: ", signif(tf_inf$G_score_scaled, 4)),
  paste0("influence_score (scaled): ", signif(tf_inf$influence_score, 4))
)

table_grob <- make_table_grob(summary_lines, fontsize = table_fontsize, bg_alpha = table_bg_alpha)

p_legend <- wrap_grob_plot(legend_grob)
p_table  <- wrap_grob_plot(table_grob)

right_col <- p_legend / p_table + plot_layout(heights = c(0.62, 0.38))
final_plot <- p_main | right_col + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.36))

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------
ggsave(out_pdf, final_plot, width = out_width, height = out_height, device = cairo_pdf)
message("Saved plot to: ", out_pdf)
```
